name: alpha-judge
description: LLM-judge stage of an alpha-mining pipeline: take a miner's deterministic candidate list, keep only real signal, drop noise, and propose additions to that miner's curated note. Use after any zero-token detector run. Reads only the candidate digest and the home note, never the corpus. Triggers: "/alpha-judge <miner>", "judge the candidates".
